# E0213: private item

Only an item marked `pub` can be named outside its module. Mark it `pub` in its module, or use what that module exports.

- Rule: [`program.visibility`](../../reference/04-programs.md#program.visibility)
- Reported at: the private item's or member's name.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `types` phase

## What the compiler prints

The program [`E0213_private_item`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0213_private_item):

`helpers.lt`:

```stilt fragment
fn greeting() -> str { "hello" }
```

`main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
use helpers

fn main() / io { print(helpers.greeting()) }
```

What `stilt check` prints for it:

```text
── PRIVATE ITEM ────────────────────────────────────────── main.lt:3:32  [E0213]

`helpers.greeting` is private to module `helpers`:

  3 │ fn main() / io { print(helpers.greeting()) }
    │                                ^^^^^^^^

Only an item marked `pub` can be named outside its module. Mark it `pub` in its
module, or use what that module exports.
```
